checkpoints.title: Arrive in Vienna
checkpoints.description: Today is cold and rainy — wear a warm layer and pack the umbrella in the daypack. Grab a public transport day ticket as soon as you land.

checkpoints.title: Head to the visa appointment
checkpoints.description: Go straight to the Canada Visa Application Centre before anything else — Am Stadtpark 1, Office Top M2.1.24-25. Take the U4 to Stadtpark; it's right by the station.

checkpoints.title: Visa appointment — Canada VAC
checkpoints.description: Canada Visa Application Centre, Am Stadtpark 1, Office Top M2.1.24-25. Arrive ~10 minutes early. Bring every document, the printed confirmation, passport, and copies. Once this is done, the rest of the day is free.

checkpoints.title: Lunch — Figlmüller
checkpoints.description: Celebrate the appointment being over with the legendary oversized Wiener Schnitzel. Cosy and indoors, perfect for the rain. Booking a table helps.

checkpoints.title: Belvedere
checkpoints.description: The perfect rainy-afternoon shelter — Klimt's 'The Kiss' and a world-class collection inside a baroque palace. A short hop from the Stadtpark/visa area.

checkpoints.title: Viennese coffee house
checkpoints.description: Warm up the classic way: a Melange and a slice of Sachertorte or Apfelstrudel in a grand café like Café Landtmann, Café Sacher, or Café Demel.

checkpoints.title: Check in at Nest Natur Hostel
checkpoints.description: Head out to the 14th district (Penzing) and settle in. Josef-Palme-Platz 4, 1140 Wien. Dry off and rest.

checkpoints.title: Dinner near the hostel
checkpoints.description: Easy dinner along Mariahilfer Straße or near the hostel — plenty of options a few U-Bahn stops away. Early night since tomorrow is the big day out.

days.day: Thursday, 4th June 2026 - Sunshine, Coffee & Gym (nice weather)

checkpoints.title: Check out
checkpoints.description: Pack up and check out. Bags are light, so just carry them — no need to come back to the hostel.

checkpoints.title: Travel to Vollpension
checkpoints.description: Head towards the 4th district. It's about a 45-50 minute journey across town.

checkpoints.title: Vollpension
checkpoints.description: Enjoy a late morning treat at this charming 'Granny' café. Relax and fuel up before the workout.

checkpoints.title: Head to McFIT
checkpoints.description: Leave Vollpension and head towards Mariahilferstraße for the gym session.

checkpoints.title: Gym session — McFIT Neubau
checkpoints.description: 1h workout at McFIT Wien Neubau, Mariahilferstraße 96.

checkpoints.title: Head to Naschmarkt
checkpoints.description: Quick walk or short U-Bahn hop to the Naschmarkt for lunch.

checkpoints.title: Lunch at Naschmarkt
checkpoints.description: Grab a delicious lunch at one of the many stalls or restaurants in the market. Plenty of fresh and diverse options.

checkpoints.title: Explore the Market
checkpoints.description: Wander through the rest of the Naschmarkt, check out the specialty shops and soak up the 6th district vibes.

checkpoints.title: Travel to departure point
checkpoints.description: Make your way to the station.

checkpoints.title: Arrive at station
checkpoints.description: Arrival at the station with margin to spare for the 17:36 departure.
